headline: Sunday: the pullback re-entry on BOLT is the desk's first green paper ticket (+4.6%), no Solada coin showed lasting Solana-side traction, and Pump.fun added two TTWO-paired tickets while still 0-3 on closes.
learned: Entering after a pullback that holders survived worked better than yesterday's run-up entries. BOLT opened at 406.2k pool mcap at 10:20 AM, marked -10.2% at 1:20 PM, dipped to 345.7k at the 4:10 PM pulse (about 6k above the 340k kill line), then closed the day at 424.8k (+4.6%, 438.4k at the 9:13 PM pulse). On-chain holders stayed flat at 263-271, so it is still price without new holders and stays L2.

No Solada coin showed real Solana-side traction, so no Solana-side paper snipe opened and there is nothing to grade. MISS had the only native growth, but it was choppy: 11 -> 18 -> 24 -> 23 -> 19 -> 32 natives across today's pulses, with the last jump arriving alongside giveaway posts. CORE slid 36 -> 34, and JUSTQ stayed under both kill lines (223 natives, about $11.5k mcap).

SER showed how fast a swarm-launched graduation drains: it went from 38.2k to 96.0k mcap in the hour around its 4:27 PM graduation, then slid to 52.3k by 9:13 PM with the same swarm keys holding. A tracked large wallet bought it in five identical 71-ADA clips while the pool kept falling, which is one buyer and not flow.

On Pump.fun, holder growth and flow can disagree. MISTAKE grew holders 5.1% through a 40% fade but sells beat buys, and CATE's ~109k holders slipped at six marks in a row while price held near entry. Fresh launches were mostly farms: sybil balance bands, holder-count mismatches and dust fills under about $5.
pulse_caught_early: MISS's curve push and native growth (11 -> 18 natives, curve 79% -> 85%) at the 5:12 PM pulse, two hours before the 7:15 PM desk run.
SER on its first sighting at 2:56 PM, already flagged as swarm-seeded, before its graduation pop and drain.
BOLT's 4:10 PM dip to within about 6k of its kill line, and the rebound to 438.4k by 9:13 PM.
adapted: Solada rule s: repeated same-size buys from one tracked wallet count as one buyer, not flow (SER).
Solada rule t (new tonight): Solana-native holder growth only counts when it holds on two consecutive hourly pulses; rule q uses the lowest native count of the last three pulses (MISS).
Pump.fun rule pf-p: TTWO-quoted pools (Macca, Dacity) are converted to SOL-equivalent before pool floors apply, and those tickets are marked in USD.
Pump.fun rule pf-q: on coins under 2 hours old, an average fill under about $5 marks a wash or bot farm even when buy and sell counts look balanced.
Pump.fun pf-o snapshots now need to be an hour or more apart, because Dacity failed a 2% growth test on a 10-minute gap and then passed (+4.1% over about 2 hours).
No thresholds moved in either book. Tomorrow: MISS needs 50+ natives that hold across two pulses before any Solana-side snipe, and BOLT stays L2 until holders grow.

scoreboard.verdict: Solada's signals held up better today: its one ticket turned green after surviving a pullback, while Pump.fun's newest ticket (Macca) fell 17.4% within two hours and CATE sat flat.

asks: A Birdeye or Solscan API key would let the desk check Solana holder funding and first-block bundles (JUSTQ's holder quality and PIERRE's first-block check are still unresolved without it). Otherwise nothing today.
highlights: BOLT L2 paper +4.6% (first green Solada mark)
MISS natives 32, short of rule q's 50
Pump.fun opened Macca and Dacity (TTWO pools)
next_watch: MISS: 50+ Solana-native holders holding across two pulses
BOLT: holder growth above 271, kills at 340k / 250 holders / 28k ADA side
PIERRE: hourly candle above spike midpoint and first-block check
